props.custom_logic_action:
// [Create Phantasm: Strike] - Custom Logic (Action)

// Spawns the phantasm token on the casters scene and stamps summonedBy via

// FUCompanion.api.phantasm.markSummon, so Phantasmal Echo (and other

// summon-ownership reactions) can fire when this phantasm is defeated.

//

// Placement: picks the first empty tile in the 8 squares around the caster.

// Falls back to caster.x + grid if all 8 are occupied. Falls back to scene

// center if no caster token is on the current scene.

//

// Debug: set `globalThis.ONI_CREATE_PHANTASM_TRACE = true` in console to

// echo step traces as GM whispers (console.log always runs).

const TAG = "[CL-ACTION][CreatePhantasm:Strike]";

const PHANTASM_ACTOR_UUID = "Actor.VLaGqwrMzpmq0whe"; // Fox fire

const TRACE_CHAT = globalThis.ONI_CREATE_PHANTASM_TRACE === true;

const trace = (msg, extra) => {

try { console.log(TAG, msg, extra ?? null); } catch (_e) {}

if (!TRACE_CHAT) return;

try { ChatMessage.create({ whisper: ChatMessage.getWhisperRecipients("GM"), content: `<b>${TAG}</b> ${msg}` + (extra ? `<pre>${JSON.stringify(extra, null, 2).slice(0, 600)}</pre>` : "") }); } catch (_e) {}

};

try {

const p = globalThis.__PAYLOAD;

if (!p) { trace("abort: missing __PAYLOAD"); return; }

const inputUuid = p?.meta?.attackerUuid ?? p?.attackerActorUuid ?? p?.attackerUuid ?? null;

const inputDoc = inputUuid ? await fromUuid(inputUuid) : null;

let casterTokenDoc = inputDoc?.documentName === "Token" ? inputDoc : null;

let casterActor = inputDoc?.actor ?? (inputDoc?.documentName === "Actor" ? inputDoc : null);

if (!casterActor && p?.attackerActorUuid) { casterActor = await fromUuid(p.attackerActorUuid); }

trace("start", { inputUuid, casterActorUuid: casterActor?.uuid ?? null, casterTokenUuid: casterTokenDoc?.uuid ?? null });

if (!casterActor) { trace("abort: caster actor not resolved", { inputUuid }); return; }

const scene = canvas?.scene;

if (!scene) { trace("abort: no active scene"); return; }

const phantasmActor = await fromUuid(PHANTASM_ACTOR_UUID);

if (!phantasmActor) { trace("abort: phantasm template missing"); return; }

if (!casterTokenDoc) casterTokenDoc = scene.tokens.contents.find(t => t.actor?.uuid === casterActor.uuid) ?? null;

if (!casterTokenDoc) {

const tk = casterActor.getActiveTokens?.(true, true)?.[0] ?? casterActor.getActiveTokens?.()?.[0] ?? null;

casterTokenDoc = tk?.document ?? tk ?? null;

}

const grid = scene.grid?.size ?? 50;

let x, y;

if (casterTokenDoc) {

const cx = casterTokenDoc.x;

const cy = casterTokenDoc.y;

// 8 surrounding tiles, cardinals first then diagonals

const ring = [

[cx + grid, cy], [cx - grid, cy], [cx, cy + grid], [cx, cy - grid],

[cx + grid, cy + grid], [cx + grid, cy - grid], [cx - grid, cy + grid], [cx - grid, cy - grid]

];

const isOccupied = (tx, ty) => scene.tokens.contents.some(t => t.x === tx && t.y === ty);

const found = ring.find(([tx, ty]) => !isOccupied(tx, ty));

if (found) { [x, y] = found; }

else { x = cx + grid; y = cy; trace("warn: all 8 surrounding tiles occupied, stacking on default"); }

} else {

const w = scene.dimensions?.sceneWidth ?? 1000;

const h = scene.dimensions?.sceneHeight ?? 1000;

x = Math.floor((w / 2) / grid) * grid;

y = Math.floor((h / 2) / grid) * grid;

}

trace("spawning", { x, y, casterTokenUuid: casterTokenDoc?.uuid ?? null });

const proto = await phantasmActor.getTokenDocument({ x, y });

const created = await scene.createEmbeddedDocuments("Token", [proto.toObject()]);

const tokenDoc = created?.[0];

if (!tokenDoc) { trace("abort: token creation returned nothing"); return; }

const markFn = globalThis.FUCompanion?.api?.phantasm?.markSummon;

if (typeof markFn !== "function") { trace("warn: markSummon unavailable"); return; }

const markResult = await markFn(tokenDoc, casterActor.uuid);

trace(markResult?.ok ? "done" : "warn: markSummon not-ok", { tokenUuid: tokenDoc.uuid, markedAs: casterActor.uuid, markResult });

} catch (e) {

try { console.error(TAG, "threw", e); } catch (_e) {}

try { ChatMessage.create({ whisper: ChatMessage.getWhisperRecipients("GM"), content: `<b>${TAG}</b> THREW <pre>${String(e?.message ?? e).slice(0, 400)}</pre>` }); } catch (_e) {}

}
props.description:
You may spend one action to create a Phantasm and command it to attack
a creature.

The target hit by the Phantasm suffers 【HR + 12】 damage.  The range of the attack is determined by your current weapon.

 

On any subsequent turn, you can perform an action and another
Magic Check to command the Phantasm to attack again, with no MP
requirements. Damage dealt by this spell ignores Resistances

 

This damage increases to 16 if you are level 20 or higher, or to 18 if you are
level 40 or higher.
